Liberated settlements: Nove (key Russian hub), Ridkodub, Katerynivka; restored control over Karpivka and Novomykhailivka
Ukrainian forces used modified Soviet-era BTR-60 armored vehicles converted to remotely operated strike systems
Operation Vivaldi announced September 15, 2026; first phase cleared 75 sq km

title: South Korea Demands Ukraine Apology Over North Korean POW Transfer Disclosure
summary: South Korea lodged a formal protest with Ukraine and demanded an apology after Ukraine publicly disclosed its transfer of North Korean prisoners of war, citing breach of confidentiality agreement and diplomatic protocol violations.

title: Iran Escalates Security Measures as Student Protests Over Hijab and Fees Spread
summary: Motorcycle patrols and checkpoints have increased across Iranian cities amid student protests against compulsory hijab policies and rising fees.
